# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Setup ------------------------------------------------------------
source(here::here("R", "packages.R"))
source(here::here("R", "summarise.R"))
source(here::here("R", "plots.R"))
df_prev <- load_sim(here::here("results", "ipw", "prevDGP2correct.csv.gz"))
summ_prev <- summarise_sim(df_prev) |>
  mutate(tpf = factor(treat_prop, sort(unique(treat_prop), decreasing = TRUE)))
```

# Increasing SNR

```{r}
dfm <- summ_prev
prev_extra <- list(facet_wrap(~n, nrow = 1, labeller = lab_n),
                   labs(x = "treated share"))
# RMSE | |Bias| vs treated share, faceted by n
for (oc in c("linear", "quad1")) print(panel(dfm, oc, x = tpf, extra = prev_extra))
# bal0 vs oracle
for (oc in c("linear", "quad1")) print(
  panel(dfm, oc, x = tpf, ests = c("balnet0", "oracle_hajek", "oracle_ht"),
        extra = prev_extra))
#- table -#
perf_table(dfm, cols = c("treat_prop", "n"),
           span_lab = \(x) paste0("treated share = ", x), span_desc = TRUE,
           group = "outcome", title = "Prevalence grid, iid, correct spec (c = 1)")
#- MSE decomp -#
for (oc in c("linear", "quad1")) print(
  decomp_plot(filter(dfm, outcome == oc), x = treat_prop, cols = n,
              xlab = "treated share",
              x_scale = scale_x_continuous(trans = c("log2", "reverse"),
                                           breaks = c(0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5)),
              title = paste("MSE Decomposition (%) \u2014", oc_labs[oc])))
#- extreme estimates -#
extreme_heat(dfm, "glmnetcv_hajek", x = treat_prop, xlab = "treated share",
             x_desc = TRUE)
```

- Bal0 is the performs the best when treatment allocation is degraded.

- balnet.cv is outperformed by MLE, cross validation criterion is sensitive to unequal treatment allocations.
